verdict.rationale: dltHub runs managed infrastructure and an AI harness that works with coding agents, so a data-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a policy or control. Local and self-hosted deployment options are a different capability, not an AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
